cs.t: The biggest problem of EarPods is that when it doesn't fit the ear canal, it *really* doesn't fit. There's no way to sort of make it stay inside; it just slides out like a skateboard. I have such ears, and earpods are simply useless to me. The cable is also quite fragile in my experience. The material gets sticky after a few years and it sometimes frays. On the other hand, I have a pair of UE that has gone through washing machine and still going strong after 7 years.
